signature.name: Freeze-Frame Brandability (the cup sleeve test)
signature.description: Pause at 0s, 1.25s, 2.5s, 3.75s and the worst frame I can scrub to, print each in one ink at 2cm on kraft, and ask whether every still is a composed, ownable mark that belongs to one family.

lesson: In coffee, the strong work puts the motion inside the drink and makes every still printable on a sleeve; the weak work bolts a UI gesture (a spin, a fill, a counter) onto a cup and calls it ritual.

bare-wire.signature_why: Every sampled still is the same top-down cup with an off-centre dark mark in a different size and place, a stamp family that survives one ink; the bare-field frames at 0s and 2.5s are plain but not broken.
bare-wire.loved: The hole now genuinely closes from the edge in, at a 2.5s settle, so the crema heals the wound instead of drawing a second ripple; six shapes, nothing wasted.
bare-wire.docked: At 120px a brown dot in a brown circle still needs the caption to say 'drop in crema', and the top-down cup silhouette is centred-icon generic.
bare-wire.fix_note: Heal disc deleted, scar opens in 0.3s, holds, closes over 1.7s, two off-centre drops per loop at 2.5s; built as written and verified in code.

warm-hands.signature_why: Each still is a composed hand-made cup, but frames are only rotations of one decal, the sienna tip collides with the stain ring at some angles, and the stream poking above the rim breaks the silhouette at sleeve size.
warm-hands.loved: Still the only entry that looks like a specific cafe: wobbled rim, stain, thumb smudge, and the new stream gives the glance 'milk is going in'.
warm-hands.docked: The finished latte art still spins 360 degrees as a rigid decal, so the spinner read survives, and the fixed stream lands on the pivot while the pour tip runs around the rim, which is not how a pour works.
warm-hands.fix_note: Rejected for seam and Safari risk; the seam worry is fair but a 15-degree drift loops as cleanly as a full turn, so the reason only half holds and the spinning-decal problem the note targeted is still on screen.

the-glitch.signature_why: Every still is a tidy side-view cup on a saucer with a drop at a different height, composed and printable, but it is a stock cup silhouette and the crema count disappears in one ink.
the-glitch.loved: The UI chrome is gone and the coffee itself keeps score: the crema lightens a step per landing, and the 3s espresso pull is a real barista moment, not a render bug.
the-glitch.docked: The crema climbs to near full and then drains in 0.25s at 4.75s, a fill-and-reset that reads as a fake finish, and the .98 'breathe' is decoration nobody can see.
the-glitch.fix_note: Pips and band deleted, count moved onto the surface ellipse, gush built as a scaleY stream; but the reset I asked to hide behind a cup swap became a visible drain.
